_README: GENERATED — a one-time console dump of the cosmere-rpg system's heroic-paths compendium ids
from Ben's Foundry install, originally saved to C:/tmp/heroic_ids.json (2026-06-04) and moved
into the repo as a tracked snapshot by TODO_REPO_HYGIENE #17. Do not hand-edit; re-dump after
a system upgrade (see AUTHORING_WORKFLOW.md's toolbox note).
Maps SYSTEM heroic-path talent names (e.g. "Composed", "Seek Quarry") to their Foundry
document ids, so scripts/foundry-build.js's classifyToken() can resolve a prose prerequisite
naming a system talent to Compendium.cosmere-rpg.heroic-paths.Item.<id> instead of silently
degrading it to a narrative clause. Read from DATA via loadJson (scripts/lib/data.js), which
THROWS naming the file if it is missing or malformed; EDHA_HEROIC_IDS overrides the path for
The exact console snippet used for the original 2026-06-04 dump was not preserved alongside
it, so none is claimed here. A snippet in this same shape (compendium name -> {name: id} map,
via game.packs.get('cosmere-rpg.heroic-paths').getDocuments()) will reproduce it for a re-dump.
